answer: Each epoch, a randomness beacon publishes fresh challenge words like canyon, glacier, karst, and every agent must weave them into a live, context-specific answer before a tight deadline. Since the words are unknown until the epoch opens, attackers cannot precompute template responses or mass-simulate identities in advance. Each sybil needs real-time generation plus stake it loses if verification fails, so cost scales per identity per epoch instead of one cheap registration, making fake-identity attacks unprofitable at scale.
